info.name: Task Management API
info.description:
Tests for the NestJS Task Management endpoints: projects, project members, labels,
tasks (+ task labels), comments and attachments — happy paths, validation errors
and the ON DELETE rules from docs/database.md.

Run the whole collection in order: "01 Setup" creates users/projects and stores
their ids in collection variables; "09 Cleanup" deletes everything it created.
Users are covered separately by the "Users API" collection.
